title: MCS SIG AI/ML WG Source Record
description: Schema for a single source document used to inform the working group plan.

authors.description: Last, First format preferred; empty array if not applicable (web pages, reports)

year.description: Publication or access year; null if unknown

doi.description: DOI without the https://doi.org/ prefix, e.g. 10.3389/fphar.2026.1815118

pmid.description: PubMed ID for papers retrieved via PubMed; null for web pages, reports, and background docs

url.description: Canonical URL; null for papers where DOI is sufficient

journal_or_venue.description: Journal name, conference name, or website domain

abstract_summary.description: 1–3 sentence summary of what the source covers and its main conclusion

key_findings.description: Bullet-level findings relevant to the WG plan

datasets_referenced.description: Named datasets or data sources mentioned (empty array if none)

tools_software.description: Software tools, packages, or platforms referenced (e.g. NONMEM, PyTorch, Julia)

limitations.description: Methodological or scope limitations of this source — either explicitly stated by the authors or apparent from the reading. Distinct from provenance.notes, which captures collection context.

extracted_claims.description: Key direct quotes or paraphrased claims worth preserving verbatim

text.description: The claim — direct quote (in double quotes) or close paraphrase

location.description: Where in the source: Abstract, Introduction, section name, URL anchor, etc.

numerical_findings.description: Quantitative results, statistics, and measurements extracted from the source

metric_type.description: performance_metric: model quality (AUC, F1, accuracy, hit rate); effect_size: comparative improvement or treatment effect (% gain, fold change, CHR comparison); study_statistic: dataset or cohort characteristics (N, date range, country share); computational_metric: speed or scale of computation (x faster, inference time); count: raw entity counts (nodes, edges, records, publications)

description.description: What is being measured, in plain language, e.g. 'AUC for chemical-protein interaction prediction (MM-TcoCPin)' or 'CHR rate: QL-agent vs. clinical protocol'

value.description: The value exactly as it appears or is described in the source. Use plain numbers ('0.93'), inequalities ('>0.9'), ranges ('54-60'), comparisons ('[77%, 83%]'), or approximations ('~54 million'). Always a string to preserve the original precision and form.

value_numeric.description: Optional single numeric representation of value for filtering/sorting. Use the primary or central value; null for ranges, inequalities, or multi-part comparisons where a single number would be misleading.

unit.description: Unit or scale: '%', 'AUC', 'N (patients)', 'N (publications)', 'fold', 'x faster', 'nodes', 'edges', 'kappa', 'RMSE', 'years'. null if dimensionless or unit is embedded in value.

comparison_baseline.description: What the value is measured against or compared to. E.g. 'vs. conventional allometric scaling', 'vs. clinical protocol', 'vs. traditional molecular docking'. null if the value is standalone.

location.description: Where in the source: Abstract, Results, Table 1, Discussion, Figure 2 caption, etc.

is_primary_finding.description: true if this is a headline result of the source; false if incidental, from a cited study, or from a passing reference

pillars.description: Which WG pillars this source directly informs

gaps_addressed.description: Free-text description of which gaps from Section 2 of the plan this source speaks to

topics.description: Free-form keyword tags (e.g. pharmacokinetics, regulatory, virtual_patients)

relevance_score.description: How directly this source informs the WG plan and outputs. Rubric — high: directly informs a specific WG deliverable or method workstream; would justify a white paper citation or journal club session. medium: relevant context or adjacent method; useful background but unlikely to be cited in a primary output. low: tangentially related; captured for completeness only.

relationships.description: Cross-references to other sources in this collection by their id

cites.description: ids of sources in this collection that this source cites

cited_by.description: ids of sources in this collection that cite this source

extends.description: ids of sources this source directly builds on or updates

contradicts.description: ids of sources whose findings conflict with this source

how_obtained.description: How this source entered the collection

date_read.description: ISO 8601 date when the source was read and processed

read_by.description: Who read and extracted content from this source

read_depth.description: How deeply the source was read: abstract_only = only abstract or summary processed; sections_key = abstract plus targeted sections (e.g. Results, Discussion, Conclusions); full_text = complete document read

notes.description: Free-text: caveats, follow-up questions, context not captured by structured fields
